selection.reference_plan: Annotate raw real RGB before new simulator outputs. Select a clear fully visible natural vehicle if identifiable across all three frames. selection.strongest_allowed_claim: Frozen image-annotation screening under provider-declared correspondence; strict matched real-sim provenance and physical sensor/AD equivalence unqualified.

vehicle_question.reason: All selected raw pictures show road, park vegetation, curb and poles; no identifiable vehicle supports a positive vehicle-position question. Do not interpret this as a HUGSIM failure or hidden-object absence.

reference_annotations.annotation_policy: Two source-only Codex reads. Reference interval is the conservative hull of candidate readings, frozen before sim. They share the same image source and do not count as independent truth votes. Unclear object identity or contour is unknown; no fitting to sim.
reference_annotations.coordinate_convention: Pixel coordinates of visible contour; half-open vertical band [200,240), horizontal midpoint of shaft outer contours; not darkest ridge.

reading_independence.reference: Two source-only Codex reads before new sim output; shared source images, no independent truth votes.

provenance.role: frozen real-image landmark render diagnostic; no automated landmark scoring

wrong_yaw_candidate_positions_overlap_re.reason: Three deliberately commanded wrong-yaw candidate intervals were disjoint from the frozen source-image intervals, with minimum gaps57,45,44px. RGB/time/hash inputs were valid; no unqualified/missing reading was counted.

source_init_candidate_positions_overlap_.reason: Three source-init candidate intervals were disjoint with minimum gaps26,24,29px. This rejects candidate-interval compatibility, not physical calibration or the simulator component.

strict_physical_source_pairing_verified.reason: Original nuScenes identities, conversion and calibration provenance, coordinate gauge reconciliation, release pairing and training split were not independently qualified.

natural_vehicle_position_was_evaluated.reason: The metadata-selected raw window had no identifiable vehicle supporting the intended positive vehicle-position question; no vehicle coordinate was invented.

candidate_interval_overlap_establishes_p.reason: Codex visual candidate intervals are not human ground truth or calibrated uncertainty; interval overlap is only a necessary coarse consistency check.

this_experiment_establishes_AD_or_genera.reason: No AD, driving-task margin, natural vehicle-positive reference, depth or closed-loop outcome was tested.

source_member_integrity.expected: Three preselected source members must have matching archiveCRC,length,SHA256 and decode to800x450RGB.
source_member_integrity.implication: Local content integrity only, not original nuScenes token provenance or source/checkpoint pairing.

bounded_comparison_implementation.component: candidate interval evaluator and single-camera selection
bounded_comparison_implementation.expected: Interval touching remains nonconflict; strict disjointness is measured annotation conflict; unknowns remain unmeasured; input failures cannot become position contradictions; single-camera selection still validates full metadata group.
bounded_comparison_implementation.observed: 7/7 interval/integrity tests and9/9 renderer selection tests passed;full3frame metadata groups andyaw-onlycomposition verified.
bounded_comparison_implementation.implication: Qualification concerns supplied annotation algebra and interface checks, not automated natural-object measurement or physical uncertainty.

released_candidate_agreement.component: rendered image candidate landmark position under released records
released_candidate_agreement.expected: Compare the released candidate shaft midpoint interval to the frozen raw-image reference without adapting the reference to the render.
released_candidate_agreement.observed: 3/3 released intervals overlap; root, blinded reader and conservative hull gave the same categories.
released_candidate_agreement.implication: A coarse source-picture reference did not exclude these images; physical calibration, sensor/AD fitness and annotated truth remain unqualified.

controlled_wrong_view_annotation_conflic.component: deliberate camera-yaw control and interval screening
controlled_wrong_view_annotation_conflic.expected: A known wrong-camera view should produce a readable landmark interval excluded by the frozen source-picture reference.
controlled_wrong_view_annotation_conflic.observed: 3/3 wrong-view intervals were strictly disjoint;minimum gaps57,45,44px;all inputs valid;root/blind/hull categories agree.
controlled_wrong_view_annotation_conflic.implication: Supports inspectable candidate-annotation exclusion of this commanded perturbation, not a discovered HUGSIM defect or a population detection rate.

metadata_choice_annotation_conflict.component: source-init metadata applied directly to released reconstruction
metadata_choice_annotation_conflict.expected: The source-init candidate landmark intervals would remain compatible with the frozen source-picture intervals.
metadata_choice_annotation_conflict.observed: 3/3 source-init intervals disjoint;minimum gaps26,24,29px;released counterparts overlap.
metadata_choice_annotation_conflict.implication: Audit metadata choice and coordinate conversion; source/release gauge and pairing are unresolved, so no physical component is isolated.

limitations: The selected positive vehicle-position question remains unmeasured because no identifiable vehicle was available in the frozen raw window.
Same scene, one camera and3newtimes do not establish an independently held-out reconstruction split.
Candidate intervals do not establish human or calibrated sensor truth.
Source-init and released records have unresolved coordinate and release dependencies; their numeric pose difference is not an actual physical-camera error.
A supplied annotation can be wrong despite valid imagehash; the evaluator does not automatically verify its object semantics.
Interval intersection is necessary only, not sufficientaccuracy.
No AD, depth, real driving margin orclosedloopoutcome was tested.
next_bounded_step: Audit source-init/released coordinate conversion and source/reference qualification before adding vehicle-positive samples or more same-scene pass counts.
